title: Clean-slate Initialization for WAI CLI Rebuild v2
description: This task enforces a non-negotiable, from-scratch rebuild of the WAI CLI. Before any implementation, the codebase MUST be placed into a provable clean state. Required actions include deleting/archiving old code, creating a new 'cli/' folder, initializing a fresh scaffold, removing compiled artifacts, and verifying a clean git status. Prohibited actions include copying legacy files, incremental refactors, commented-out legacy logic, or shared utilities not explicitly reintroduced. Enforcement dictates the first commit be 'chore(cli): clean‑slate initialization', containing only empty/scaffolded structure, tooling, and test harness bootstrap. Any PR without this commit is invalid.
resolution_reason: CLI rebuild v2 epic marked accepted - task part of closed epic
